rationale: For an AI Animation Studio, the interface must serve as a dark, premium canvas ('theater') that allows the highly saturated, generated video content to pop. We avoid standard SaaS grey, opting for deep midnight blues and slate to create a cinematic, high-end creator-tool aesthetic. Sharp contrasts and structured layouts borrow from pro-editing software (like DaVinci Resolve or After Effects) but simplified for mobile.

spacing_and_layout.grid: Bento Grid mobile interpretation. Avoid symmetric equal squares. Mix full-width hero cards with side-by-side metric cards.
spacing_and_layout.containers: All scrollable views must have pb-32 (padding-bottom: 128px) to account for bottom tabs and FABs. Internal card padding MUST be a generous 24px.
spacing_and_layout.borders: Radical sharpness. Use max rounded-md (6px) or completely square corners. NO overly rounded pill shapes for primary cards.
spacing_and_layout.touch_targets: Minimum 48x48 pixels for all interactive elements (React Native Accessibility Standard).

buttons.primary: Background: #E11D48, Text: #FFFFFF, Height: 56px, Border-radius: 4px, Font: Outfit SemiBold.
buttons.secondary: Background: Transparent, Border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2), Text: #FFFFFF.
buttons.ghost: Background: Transparent, Text: #A1A1AA. Active state changes text to #FFFFFF.

inputs.text: Background: #121218, Border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1), Height: 56px, Padding: 16px, Text: #FFFFFF. Focus state: Border changes to #E11D48.
inputs.textarea: Min-height: 200px, multi-line, identical styling to text input.

cards.interactive: On press down, scale to 0.98 and increase border opacity to 0.3.

bottom_tabs.style: Glassmorphism: absolute positioning at bottom, background rgba(18, 18, 24, 0.85), border-top 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05). Use BlurView if available.

screens_instructions.Auth: Dark abstract cinematic background image full screen. Overlay black/60 gradient bottom-up. Form sits at bottom 40% of screen. Minimalist inputs. 'AI Animation Studio' in large Outfit font, tracking-tight.
screens_instructions.Dashboard: Top header with Avatar and 'Welcome'. Horizontal scroll for 'Recent Drafts'. Vertical 'Bento' list for all projects. Project thumbnails must have a dark gradient overlay with title and status badge (e.g., 'Rendering 45%') layered on top. Floating Action Button (FAB) bottom right in Crimson.
screens_instructions.New_Project_Wizard: Step indicator at top (1. Script -> 2. Style -> 3. Voice -> 4. Review). Script uses large multi-line input. Style picker uses 2-column grid of image cards; selected state has a 2px Crimson border and small check icon. Voice picker uses list items with play buttons.
screens_instructions.Pipeline_Progress: The 'Control Room'. Vertical timeline. 4 nodes: Parse -> Audio -> Art -> Video. Active node pulses with an inner glow. Include a dark console box (JetBrains Mono font, 12px) showing mock AI processing logs streaming in. Preview thumbnails appear inside the node once a module completes.
screens_instructions.Scene_Breakdown: Horizontal ScrollView of 'Scene Cards'. Each card is 80vw wide. Top half is the generated background/character art. Bottom half contains the Dialogue and Mood tags. Background of the view should be completely black (#000000) to isolate the scenes.
screens_instructions.Video_Player: Edge-to-edge video component. Custom overlay controls (Play/Pause/Scrub). Below the video, a sleek 'Export & Share' bento box with quick action buttons. Hide status bar if possible.
screens_instructions.Media_Converter: Toolbox UI. Tabbed top nav (Format, Trim, Crop). Aspect ratio picker must show literal geometric rectangles (16:9 wide, 9:16 tall) for selection. Sliders for trim must look technical, like a professional Non-Linear Editor (NLE).

icons.instructions: Use thin, sharp icons. Do not fill icons unless it represents an active state in the bottom tab.

splash_bg.description: Abstract dark center with soft pink edges, use for Auth/Splash screen background

avatar.description: User profile avatar for dashboard header

style_anime.description: Anime style thumbnail for Wizard step 2

style_comic.description: Comic book style thumbnail for Wizard step 2

style_vintage.description: Vintage/Retro style thumbnail for Wizard step 2

testing.instructions: All interactive elements (TouchableOpacity, Pressable, TextInput) MUST include a 'testID' prop. Use kebab-case and role-based naming (e.g., testID='login-submit-button', testID='new-project-fab').
